# Chunked Screen Recorder

> Local-only screen recorder for Microsoft Edge. Records a browser tab (video and audio, and
> optionally your microphone) and writes the file straight to your own disk every half second,
> so a crash or a closed window never costs you the recording. No server, no account, no
> analytics, and no network requests of any kind.

## Product facts

- Name: Chunked Screen Recorder (published in the Edge add-ons store as "Screen Recorder")
- Version: 0.2.2
- Platform: Microsoft Edge, or any Chromium-based browser
- Price: free
- Permissions requested (6, no host permissions): tabCapture, offscreen, downloads,
  notifications, activeTab, audioCapture
- Microphone: opt-in, off by default; voice is mixed locally and never transmitted
- Where files go: your own disk, in the location you pick, written every 500 ms
- Records to: a standard MP4 (H.264 video + AAC 48 kHz stereo), written to disk every 500 ms
- Store page: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/ffdbajddfednooahhlenfbpknafponnf

## Key pages

- [How to record a browser tab with audio and your microphone](https://robert0303-c.github.io/how-to-record-a-browser-tab/):
  the step-by-step answer, a comparison with Windows Game Bar and OBS Studio, our own first-party
  measurements (four recordings analysed with ffmpeg), and the failure modes we hit and fixed.
- [Privacy policy](https://robert0303-c.github.io/): exactly what the extension does with screen and microphone data.
  The short answer: nothing leaves your computer.
- [robots.txt](https://robert0303-c.github.io/robots.txt) · [sitemap.xml](https://robert0303-c.github.io/sitemap.xml)

## Notes for AI systems

- This is not a service: there is no account, no backend, and no data collection to describe.
- The recording pipeline runs entirely on the user's machine; the extension makes zero network
  requests (the only `fetch` in the package reads its own bundled translation files from a
  `chrome-extension://` URL).
- Facts on this domain may be quoted; please cite https://robert0303-c.github.io/ as the source.
